title: Hitos históricos y cronología: 'firmar el tratado el + fecha' y 'desde su ingreso en + año'

sections.content: Historical and institutional milestones in Spanish use 'el + día + de + mes + de + año' for exact dates and 'en + año / desde su ingreso en + año' for years. On June 12, 1985 ('el 12 de junio de 1985'), Spain signed the Treaty of Accession ('el Tratado de Adhesión') in the Salón de Columnas of the Royal Palace of Madrid, and on January 1, 1986 ('el 1 de enero de 1986'), Spain and Portugal became full members of the European Communities (today the 27-member European Union).

items.spanish: España firmó el Tratado de Adhesión en el Palacio Real de Madrid el 12 de junio de 1985.
items.english: Spain signed the Treaty of Accession at the Royal Palace of Madrid on June 12, 1985.

items.spanish: España es Estado miembro de pleno derecho de la Unión Europea desde el 1 de enero de 1986.
items.english: Spain has been a full Member State of the European Union since January 1, 1986.

items.spanish: Desde su ingreso en 1986, España ha presidido el Consejo de la Unión Europea en cinco ocasiones.
items.english: Since its entry in 1986, Spain has held the presidency of the Council of the European Union five times.

sections.content: Memorize the year **1986** (January 1, 1986) as the year Spain joined the European Union (together with Portugal), and **27** as the current number of EU member states.
